svg.aria-label: Spain sending · Recipient delivery and required public copy
svg.title: Spain sending · Recipient delivery and required public copy
svg.desc: One final candidate · Article 4 private-issuance case · ERP issuance and required public-copy submission share a qualified boundary. Selected logical scenario: private recipient delivery plus a required public copy. Public recipient delivery is another scenario. Article 4 requires simultaneous copy submission at issuance. The critical frame is a logical proposal; qualify actual timing and failure recovery. Official legal timing is fixed. Actual ERP contracts, route evidence, business schemas and public replay/query support remain qualification gates. Source: SPEC-SEI-007; product-facing handoff is logical. SPEC-SEI-013 private/provider design remains deferred. Reconcile an unknown action without repeating a completed action.
svg.text: Spain sending · Recipient delivery and required public copy
One final candidate · Article 4 private-issuance case · ERP issuance and required public-copy submission share a qualified boundary.
Proposed logical sequence · Participants are responsibility groups; actual service placement and contracts remain open.
Solid filled arrow: request · Dashed open arrow: response · Solid open arrow: notification · Time runs down.
critical · Proposed ERP issue/copy boundary; actual protocol and failure handling require OUT-Q03 qualification
Precondition: ERP supplies stable final candidate facts and planned identity before issuance. Any change
invalidates preparation. Actual coordination needs OUT-Q03 evidence.
OUT-05/07 · Draft preparation is outside this sequence
1 · Accept exact final candidate; qualify route and representation before issuance
Save final intent and stable exchange identity.
Same key and input resume the existing exchange;
changed input conflicts. Request receipt is not
Failed, stale or ambiguous lookup holds dispatch. It cannot select the public
recipient route. Final validation or policy failure also stops external actions.
OUT-08/09 · Hold the unissued candidate for ERP resolution
Freeze the qualified plan and route version. Record delivery and PUBLIC_COPY as
separate actions, with their own destinations, identities and dependencies.
OUT-10 · OUT-INT-06 · Copy exists only if Spain policy requires it
Qualify DTS where transformation is needed.
Validate final bytes after transformation; sign or
OUT-11 · DTS is a reuse candidate, not proven coverage
Save final artefact references and send intent. Before each transmission, save
its attempt, payload hash, target, contract version and original correlation.
2 · Coordinate issuance and required copy; retain separate action results
ERP owns actual issuance. Required copy submission is simultaneous under Article 4. A durable intent alone does not prove compliance. AEAT
admission is a later independent fact.
OUT-06/12 · Final changes block the boundary before issuance
Example exception: no reliable response arrives after possible transmission.
Preserve actual ERP issue evidence. Copy outcome is unknown, not confirmed
Physical coordination must qualify races and partial failures. An issued invoice
cannot be rolled back automatically, withdrawn or reissued to recover a lost copy
OUT-Q03 · Owned recovery; no blind replay
Separate recipient action · Public-copy submission never waits for successful private delivery
Save and expose independent results. Keep confirmed recipient delivery while copy
outcome is unknown. Do not repeat the delivery or blindly resubmit the copy.
3 · Reconcile only the unknown action; keep independent evidence visible
Record the original outcome once and publish the committed change. If no reliable
observation is available, retain unknown and open an owned operations case.
Show recipient delivery and public-copy progress separately, with evidence and
required actions. API receipt, transport acknowledgement and buyer acceptance
OUT-14/15 · Lifecycle spec owns later business outcomes
Planned final identity, revision, input digest and key
Logical intake receipt; not external success
API transport and exact fields remain open
OUT-06/12 · Same prepared identity, revision and hash
Logical handoff; no physical endpoint is approved
Meaning must match this contract milestone
Only where the selected contract supports it
Example: confirms the original copy submission
OUT-14/15 · Authorised read repairs missed updates
Selected logical scenario: private recipient delivery plus a required public copy. Public recipient delivery is another scenario.
Article 4 requires simultaneous copy submission at issuance. The critical frame is a logical proposal; qualify actual timing and failure recovery.
Official legal timing is fixed. Actual ERP contracts, route evidence, business schemas and public replay/query support remain qualification gates.
Source: SPEC-SEI-007; product-facing handoff is logical. SPEC-SEI-013 private/provider design remains deferred. Reconcile an unknown action without repeating a completed action.
